long_term_goal: GPT-grade general language understanding without an external LLM reasoning dependency
implemented: typed persistent conditional guards separate from immutable modal parse relations
explicit unresolved, dialogue-supported, dialogue-contradicted, contested, and ineligible-counterfactual statuses
active-ledger evidence matching by subject, state axis, state value, temporal anchor, and actual modal world
English and Korean indicative, hypothetical, unless, and counterfactual guard ingestion
negated antecedent evaluation for unless and Korean negative conditional forms
same-source revision-aware reevaluation and cross-source conflict preservation
possible, probable, predicted, desired, and counterfactual evidence exclusion from actual guards
strict prohibition on consequent-to-antecedent reverse inference
deliberation eligibility without automatic GoalIR creation or external execution authority
bounded local English conditional-it binding to the antecedent subject
English correction-adverb removal from actor identity
guard store, guard, evidence, evaluation, truth, authority, and unsupported-claim tamper rejection

architecture.declaration_path: conditional utterance -> typed modal conditional -> persistent inactive guard -> no goal projection
architecture.evaluation_path: active actual-world dialogue records -> typed proposition signatures -> antecedent support or contradiction -> bounded guard status
architecture.activation_boundary: supported dialogue evidence -> consequent available for deliberation only -> no automatic goal, execution, or truth authority
architecture.reverse_inference_boundary: consequent observation is never used as antecedent evidence

development_counterexamples.observed: If the backup is available, restore it was rejected because sentence-internal it was treated as an unresolved prior-turn reference.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added a bounded local conditional binding from one consequent it to the typed antecedent subject.

development_counterexamples.observed: Korean conditional clauses could leave a hypothetical consequent in active conversation goals even though no current goal was inferred.
development_counterexamples.repair: Blocked all conversation-goal projection while a modal conditional relation is present; activation remains a separate deliberation-only status.

development_counterexamples.observed: Korean copular conditions such as 서비스가 정상이면 were not split into antecedent and consequent.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added bounded -이면 conditional recognition while retaining prohibition-form exclusions.

development_counterexamples.observed: Actually, Alice says ... produced actor identity actually, alice and therefore failed to supersede Alice's prior record.
development_counterexamples.repair: Removed leading English correction discourse markers before actor extraction, restoring same-source revision semantics.

development_counterexamples.observed: Possible evidence and observed consequents were tempting but invalid sources of guard support.
development_counterexamples.repair: Restricted matching to active Actual-world antecedent records and never compares the consequent against evidence.

known_limits: Antecedent matching uses a bounded proposition-signature lexicon rather than general textual entailment or theorem proving.
Conjunction, disjunction, nested conditions, quantified antecedents, numeric comparisons, and rich temporal guards are not generally evaluated.
Dialogue evidence can support a guard for deliberation but is deliberately not external-world verification.
The adapter does not yet ask for confirmation, rank sources, or execute a deliberation-eligible consequent.
Local sentence-internal reference repair currently covers one English it tied to one conditional antecedent; broader intra-sentential coreference remains incomplete.
Guard identity is based on normalized surface arms, so broad paraphrases of the same rule are not merged.
Source reliability and evidence strength are not estimated; unresolved cross-source disagreement remains contested.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade breadth, robustness, knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: long-distance actor, entity, event, and belief-holder coreference across mixed Korean and English turns
compositional paraphrase and ontology-mediated proposition matching beyond bounded surface signatures
typed causal, concessive, purpose, and explanatory relations with evidence paths
conjunctive, disjunctive, quantified, numeric, and temporal guard composition
multi-hop relational questions with calibrated abstention and explicit proof paths
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites and human-calibrated evaluation
